column1: # GemType Bangla starter words: English words and names as people type them in English letters,
# and a few everyday Bangla words typed the casual way, and how they are written in Bangla.
# Written by Matily for GemType (Apache-2.0, see NOTICE).
# One "roman<TAB>word" per line; the same roman on several lines = several words, best first.
# Romans that are also everyday Avro spellings of other Bangla words are left out (data = দাতা, car = কার).
# --- more English words, and the ways people spell them in English letters
# --- everyday Bangla words typed the casual way (t for ট, ch for চ, no ^ for ঁ), with the other word they could be
